verdicts.title: Finding Bugs in Short Proofs: The Metamathematics of Resolution Lower Bounds
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study the *refuter* problems for proof complexity lower bounds. Suppose $\varphi$ is a hard tautology that does not admit any length-$s$ proof in some proof system $P$.
